deployment.decoding: identical semantics to constrained-v2: seed '。' + context, pinyin-constrained beam width 4 with fuzzy pairs, raw-softmax geometric-mean confidence, final fuzzy gate
deployment.kv_management: one persistent prompt cache; every read rolls back to the longest common prefix and feeds only the delta (cross-path beam sharing AND cross-request base persistence)

latency_ms.note: 974 mixed-context requests through the persistent worker; each request's context differs from the previous one, which is the WORST case for the cross-request prefix cache (full context re-feed every request). Same-hardware torch rerun below; the frozen v2 doc recorded p50 280.5 / p95 568.8.

equivalence_vs_fp16.verdict: net-zero accuracy delta (both engines 898/974); the 8-bit artifact reproduces the fp16 route within quantization noise.

precision_decision_4bit.finding: 4-bit affine quantization collapses the seed-boundary next-token distribution: after seed '。', P(今天) drops 1.2e-3 (fp16) -> 3.4e-6 (4-bit) while P(禁) rises 1.3e-4 -> 1.05e-3, flipping the reference decode from 今天天气很好 to 禁天天起很好. MLX fp16 (unquantized) and 8-bit both reproduce the torch distribution.
precision_decision_4bit.verdict: 8-bit is the deployment precision. 4-bit rejected on quality grounds despite its latency/size advantage.

prefix_cache_evidence.deterministic_unit_tests: tests/test_mlx_worker.py: rollback-cache distributions are bit-identical to naive full-refeed across beam-shaped call patterns (including revisits and divergences); identical repeated requests feed zero new tokens; context extension feeds only the delta (recorded feed deltas, e.g. [13, 4] instead of the full sequence); a diverging beam path re-feeds only its new suffix ([1773,4,7] then [9]).
prefix_cache_evidence.growing_context_probe: 12 sequential requests with growing/repeating contexts (typing-session shape): per-request feed delta 0-4 tokens versus naive seed+context re-prefill of 5-12+ tokens; wall time for the whole probe including cold start 3.0s.
prefix_cache_evidence.steady_state_latency: in product form consecutive revisions of one composition share the context exactly, so every request after the first pays only beam-step feeds (~9-12ms/token measured in docs/baselines/phase2-4bit-mlx-latency-spike.json; the 8-bit step cost is within the same order - the frozen-set p50 115ms already includes the worst-case full-context-refill path).

confidence_gate_calibration.method: precision vs shown-coverage on the frozen test set at absolute geometric-mean-confidence thresholds
confidence_gate_calibration.verdict: confidence is weakly informative: raising the gate to 0.01 drops half the coverage for +3.2pp precision. Deployment min_confidence stays 0.0 (abstain only on empty/shape-invalid suggestions); revisit after LM-002 SFT sharpens the distribution.
